# OS Probabilities

Purpose: lightweight deterministic probability policies for games, apps, services, and tools.

Primary files:
- README.md: public overview and commands
- AGENTS.md: instructions for coding agents
- docs/lootbox-quickstart.md: practical lootbox integration guide
- docs/spec-v1.md: policy model and extension rules
- docs/agent-usability.md: LLM/agent usability contract
- docs/comparison.md: comparison against weighted random helpers, rules engines, and feature flags
- docs/when-not-to-use.md: scope boundaries and adoption guidance
- docs/production-integration.md: server-side integration patterns
- docs/rust-wasm.md: Rust/WASM status and roadmap
- benchmarks/README.md: current benchmark and package-size numbers
- packages/core/src/types.ts: canonical TypeScript types
- packages/core/src/engine.ts: deterministic runtime
- packages/adapters/src/index.ts: integration adapters, including lootboxes
- packages/playground/src/main.ts: hosted playground UI
- packages/schema/schema/os-probabilities-v1.schema.json: JSON Schema
- examples/real-scenarios/lootbox-pity-event/scenario.yaml: production-style lootbox scenario
- examples/integrations: production integration examples
- fixtures/determinism/golden-vectors.json: cross-runtime determinism fixtures

Useful commands:
- npm run check
- npm test
- npm run test:python
- npm run build
- npm run playground:build
- npm run benchmark -- --write benchmarks/latest.json
- npm run pack:dry
- npm run os-probabilities -- scenario examples/real-scenarios/lootbox-pity-event/scenario.yaml

Core constraints:
- No arbitrary expressions.
- Paths are only ctx.* and item.*.
- RNG is PCG32 with explicit seed derivation.
- Weight math is fixed-scale integer decimal math.
- Declared order is deterministic tie/order policy.
